data.one_liner: UI library for creating standard and AI-driven chat applications in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready-to-use widgets like SfChat and SfAIAssistView for building chat and AI assistant interfaces. Includes customizable message bubbles, authors, avatars, content editors, action buttons, and placeholders.
use_when: You need to build a standard chat messaging interface with incoming and outgoing messages.
You are integrating an AI assistant UI and need request/response message layouts with loading indicators and suggestions.
avoid_when: You need a completely free open-source package without commercial licensing requirements.
You only need networking or backend logic without UI widgets.
strengths: Comprehensive built-in customization options for message headers, footers, avatars, and content shapes.
Supports both standard chat and AI assist view use cases out of the box.
weaknesses: Requires a commercial Syncfusion license or free Community license for legal usage.
data.setup_notes: Requires a Syncfusion commercial or Community license key.
